facts.headline: NYSE Seeks Approval for Grayscale Ethereum Staking
facts.summary: The New York Stock Exchange has filed with the SEC to permit Ethereum staking within Grayscale's spot Ethereum ETF, which would let a portion of the fund's ETH generate yield. If approved, it would deepen Ethereum's institutional financialization and set a precedent for staking-based crypto ETFs.
